Vendor Terms & Conditions
Commission & Payouts

TravelMate charges 10% commission on all bookings. Payouts are processed weekly to your registered bank account.

Content Ownership

You own your package descriptions and images. You grant TravelMate permission to display them on the platform.

Booking Obligations

You must honor all confirmed bookings. Cancellations require admin approval and may result in penalties.

Quality Standards

Maintain accurate package information. Update pricing and availability regularly. Respond to customer inquiries within 24 hours.

Liability & Insurance

You are fully responsible for guest safety during trips. You must maintain proper insurance coverage. TravelMate is not liable for accidents or injuries.

Termination

TravelMate reserves the right to remove vendors who violate policies, maintain low ratings, or fail to meet quality standards.

Dispute Handling

Customer complaints are reviewed by admin. Refunds may be issued if vendors fail to deliver promised services.
